projects.name: Angular-Weather-App
projects.summary: This application utilizes Rapid API's Current Weather API to retrieve weather data and presents the acquired information through the user interface. It encompasses a feature that enables users to search for specific city or country names, resulting in the retrieval of corresponding weather data.

projects.name: Algo-Test
projects.summary: This application utilizes BANK NIFTY data ([Timestamp, LTP, Volume]) and Lightweight Charts Library to render it as a chart. It also converts the data into Open High Low Close (OHLC) format, with the ability to specify resolution.

projects.name: Build-Plotter
projects.summary: This repository hosts a Python script that creates bar graphs from a build log (build-stats.txt). The script visualizes page sizes and first load JS, aiding in comparing different builds of a web application.
